compiled_state.title: [ci-review] DD2 spec wording ambiguous: 'no findings' vs synthetic-finding fail-closed mechanism
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
The DD2 for story d7fa says 'records as failed via record-review.sh and no findings are produced'. The implementation returns a synthetic critical finding (augmentation_failed=True) which propagates through the runner's severity gate to record-review.sh. dispatch.py cannot directly call record-review.sh (circular dep). The 'no findings are produced' language contradicts using a synthetic critical finding as the fail-closed signal. Need to either (a) change DD wording to match implementation, or (b) implement DD literally (return empty findings but signal fail-closed via a separate mechanism).
Category: spec-wording
